Field manual

  1. Select a formation. Attack immediately or move once to a blue hex.
  2. Tap an unreachable hex or Deselect to cancel. Tap any enemy to inspect its stats and threat range.
  3. Only authored siege, stronghold, and defense missions deploy destructible bases. Base destruction follows that mission’s stated victory condition.
  4. Holdfast Protocol warns of waves at rounds 2, 4, and 6. Protect the Valhalla Gate through the end of round 6.
  5. Engineers can place one barricade on a glowing adjacent hex. Crossing it costs an extra movement point and it grants cover.
  6. Elevation improves defense by up to 2 and attack range by at most 1. Forest, ruins, walls, towers, and barricades grant cover.
  7. Gold-ringed allies act independently. Each surviving squad model attacks once; healers restore allied health instead.
  8. Sound begins only after you turn it on. Important dialogue uses one exclusive channel and never stacks.
  9. Complete the mission-specific objective or destroy the enemy army where elimination is allowed.
